spans.s: कोप, अस्, m. passion, anger. See s. v.

कोप कोप, अस्, m. (fr. rt. कुप्), morbid
irritation or disorder of the humours of the body;
passion, wrath, anger, rage, (स-कोप, enraged; स-को-
पम्, angrily.)
—कोप-कारण, अम्, n. cause of anger.
 — 1. कोप-क्रम, अस्, m. one who goes to anger,
an angry or passionate man.
—कोप-ज्वलित, अस्, आ,
अम्, inflamed with wrath, enraged.
—कोप-तस्, ind.
through anger, angrily.
—कोप-दीप्त, अस्, आ, अम्,
incensed or inflamed with anger.
—कोप-पद, अम्,
n. appearance of anger, pretended wrath.
—कोप-
परीत, अस्, आ, अम्, affected by anger.
—कोप-लता,
f., N. of a plant, = कर्ण-स्फोटा.
—कोप-वत्, आन्,
अती, अत्, angry; passionate; (ती), f., N. of a metre
consisting of four lines of fourteen syllables each.
—कोप-वश, अस्, m. subjection to anger.
—कोप-
वेग, अस्, m. violence, impetuosity of passion; N. of
a Ṛṣi.
—कोप-समन्वित, अस्, आ, अम्, affected by
anger.
—कोपाकुल (˚प-आक्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, furious,
enraged.
—कोपा-कोपि, ind. in mutual anger, in
reciprocal wrath.
—कोपाविष्ट (˚प-आव्˚), अस्, आ, अम्,
affected with anger.

कोपन, अस्, आ, अम्, inclined to passion, passionate,
wrathful, angry; irritating, causing morbid irritation
or disorder of the humours; (अस्), m., N. of an Asura;
(अम्), n. irritating; becoming angry; (आ), f. a pas-
sionate woman.
कोपनक, अम्, n. a kind of perfume; [cf. चोरक.]

कोपयिष्णु, उस्, उस्, उ, intending to exasperate,
inclined to make angry.
कोपित, अस्, आ, अम्, enraged, furious.

कोपिन्, ई, इनी, इ, angry, passionate, wrathful; (at
the end of a compound) irritating, stirring up; (ई),
m. a bird called the water-pigeon (जल-पारावत).

कोपक्रम 2. कोपक्रम (क-उप्˚), अम्, n.
Brahmā's creation; see 3. क. (For 1. कोप-क्रम
see under कोप above.)

कोपज्ञ कोपज्ञ (क-उप्˚), अम्, n. Brahmā's
creation.
